result.reason: The operative addition reaches the preferred position: Contractor defends and indemnifies Company and its affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Contractor-caused data incident, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims, with notice, defense control, cooperation, and settlement protections. It appropriately carves the indemnity out of the liability cap and attorneys' fee waiver. No broader Customer indemnity is introduced. The change is otherwise limited and preserves unrelated commercial terms. Minor drafting defects remain: the section title inaccurately refers to indemnification of Contractor, the source contains duplicate subsection labels, and the rendered ordering places the existing warranty before the Section 7 heading.
